registered_addition_groups.rationale: Reviewed M3-B durable shadow-write capability. RetainedRealObservationSink.append intentionally invokes the already validated M2-A SQLiteShadowStore append-only SHA-256 chain, but only after an exact ProductionCaptureRecord has passed the closed production-verifier gate. Construction stores the explicit store handle only and performs no I/O; there is no auto-initialize or auto-append. The append remains shadow_only, requires exact event-envelope/readback proof, and cannot mutate the registry owner, start the observation window, complete M3-B, open M3-C/M3-E, or authorize cutover. The adaptive finding is canonical SHA-256 encoding only.
